description: Ethereum burn pace: the EIP-1559 base-fee burn computed live from the latest two mainnet blocks on a public RPC. Burn per block, block interval, burn per day, annualized burn, and the net pace against a disclosed issuance assumption. Input: none. Output: one burn card. Price: $0.03 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: eth-burn-pace
